WITH source_data AS (
    SELECT a.HK_LISTING, a.HD_LISTING_PRICE, a.price_kzt, a.status, a.LOAD_DATETIME, a.RECORD_SOURCE
    FROM "krisha_dwh"."marts_dv"."stg_dv_price_history" AS a
    WHERE a.HK_LISTING IS NOT NULL
),

latest_records AS (
    SELECT b.HK_LISTING, b.HD_LISTING_PRICE, b.LOAD_DATETIME
    FROM (
        SELECT current_records.HK_LISTING, current_records.HD_LISTING_PRICE, current_records.LOAD_DATETIME,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY current_records.HK_LISTING
               ORDER BY current_records.LOAD_DATETIME DESC
            ) AS rank
        FROM "krisha_dwh"."marts_dv"."sat_listing_price" AS current_records
            JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT source_data.HK_LISTING
                FROM source_data
            ) AS source_records
                ON source_records.HK_LISTING = current_records.HK_LISTING
    ) AS b
    WHERE b.rank = 1
),

unique_source_records AS (
    SELECT
        b.HK_LISTING, b.HD_LISTING_PRICE, b.price_kzt, b.status, b.LOAD_DATETIME, b.RECORD_SOURCE
    FROM (
        SELECT
            sd.HK_LISTING, sd.HD_LISTING_PRICE, sd.price_kzt, sd.status, sd.LOAD_DATETIME, sd.RECORD_SOURCE,
            LAG(
                sd.HD_LISTING_PRICE,
                1,
                COALESCE(lr.HD_LISTING_PRICE,
                         CAST('FFFFFFFF' AS BYTEA))
            ) OVER (
                PARTITION BY sd.HK_LISTING
                ORDER BY sd.LOAD_DATETIME ASC
            ) AS prev_hashdiff
        FROM source_data AS sd
        LEFT OUTER JOIN latest_records AS lr
            ON sd.HK_LISTING = lr.HK_LISTING
        ) AS b
    WHERE b.HD_LISTING_PRICE != b.prev_hashdiff
),

records_to_insert AS (
    SELECT usr.HK_LISTING, usr.HD_LISTING_PRICE, usr.price_kzt, usr.status, usr.LOAD_DATETIME, usr.RECORD_SOURCE
    FROM unique_source_records AS usr
)

    a.seller_type,
    a.district_name,
    hc.city_name,
    hl.load_datetime AS first_seen_at,
    p.price_kzt,
    p.status,
    p.price_since,
    NULL::timestamptz AS posted_at,
    CASE
        WHEN a.area_total_m2 > 0 THEN p.price_kzt / a.area_total_m2
    END AS price_per_m2_kzt
FROM "krisha_dwh"."marts_dv"."hub_listing" hl
LEFT JOIN attrs_latest a ON a.hk_listing = hl.hk_listing
LEFT JOIN price_latest p ON p.hk_listing = hl.hk_listing
LEFT JOIN "krisha_dwh"."marts_dv"."lnk_listing_city" l ON l.hk_listing = hl.hk_listing
LEFT JOIN "krisha_dwh"."marts_dv"."hub_city" hc ON hc.hk_city = l.hk_city

WITH price_versions AS (
    SELECT
        sp.hk_listing,
        sp.price_kzt,
        sp.status,
        sp.load_datetime AS valid_from,
        LEAD(sp.load_datetime) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.hk_listing
                                     ORDER BY sp.load_datetime) AS valid_to,
        LAG(sp.price_kzt)    OVER (PARTITION BY sp.hk_listing
                                     ORDER BY sp.load_datetime) AS prev_price_kzt
    FROM "krisha_dwh"."marts_dv"."sat_listing_price" sp
),
attrs_latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            sa.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.hk_listing
                               ORDER BY sa.load_datetime DESC) AS rn
        FROM "krisha_dwh"."marts_dv"."sat_listing_attributes" sa
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    hl.listing_id,
    pv.price_kzt,
    pv.status,
    pv.valid_from,
    pv.valid_to,
    pv.prev_price_kzt,
    pv.price_kzt - pv.prev_price_kzt AS price_delta_kzt,
    a.deal_type,
    a.property_type,
    a.rooms,
    a.area_total_m2,
    a.district_name,
    a.complex_name,
    hc.city_name
FROM price_versions pv
JOIN "krisha_dwh"."marts_dv"."hub_listing" hl ON hl.hk_listing = pv.hk_listing
LEFT JOIN attrs_latest a ON a.hk_listing = pv.hk_listing
LEFT JOIN "krisha_dwh"."marts_dv"."lnk_listing_city" l ON l.hk_listing = pv.hk_listing
LEFT JOIN "krisha_dwh"."marts_dv"."hub_city" hc ON hc.hk_city = l.hk_city
